fees.notes: No international fee published for a generic Bachelor of Education: UIS offers BE01 Education (Hons) TESL with Multimedia (https://study.uis.edu.my/be01), BE02 Islamic Education with Multimedia (Hons) (https://study.uis.edu.my/be02) and BE03 Education with Honors (Tahfiz & Al-Qiraat) (https://study.uis.edu.my/be03); the July 2024 official pages for BE01 and BE02 publish Malaysian fees only, with no international total, and the current pages say fee information will be updated soon (accessed 2026-09-18). International fee left null because no official figure is published.
